description: Add medical domain extensions to the medbook_booking module: Doctor Profile, Clinic, Specialization entities with full SQL schema, Entity classes, admin controllers, grid definitions, form types, and routes. Add visit_type (stacjonarna/online) and insurance_type (NFZ/prywatne) fields to bookings. All in Polish.
steps: Create additional SQL in modules/medbook_booking/sql/install.sql for new medical tables: PREFIX_medbook_doctor_profile (id_doctor_profile, id_resource FK, specialization_id, education TEXT, experience_years INT, languages VARCHAR, certifications TEXT, photo VARCHAR, nip VARCHAR(10), pwz_number VARCHAR(7), consultation_online TINYINT, consultation_inperson TINYINT, date_add, date_upd), PREFIX_medbook_clinic (id_clinic, name VARCHAR(255), address VARCHAR(255), city VARCHAR(128), postal_code VARCHAR(6), voivodeship VARCHAR(64), lat DECIMAL(10,8), lng DECIMAL(11,8), phone VARCHAR(32), email VARCHAR(128), opening_hours_json TEXT, is_active TINYINT, date_add, date_upd), PREFIX_medbook_doctor_clinic (id_doctor_clinic, id_resource INT, id_clinic INT, room_number VARCHAR(32), is_primary TINYINT, PRIMARY KEY, INDEX), PREFIX_medbook_specialization (id_specialization, name VARCHAR(128), slug VARCHAR(128), icon VARCHAR(64), is_active TINYINT, position INT), PREFIX_medbook_document (id_document, id_customer INT, id_booking INT, document_type ENUM prescription/referral/result/other, filename VARCHAR(255), original_name VARCHAR(255), mime_type VARCHAR(64), file_size INT, uploaded_by ENUM patient/doctor/admin, date_add DATETIME)

Add visit_type ENUM('stacjonarna','online') DEFAULT 'stacjonarna' and insurance_type ENUM('NFZ','prywatne','pakiet') DEFAULT 'prywatne' and video_call_url VARCHAR(512) DEFAULT NULL columns to PREFIX_medbook_booking table in install.sql

Create Entity classes: modules/medbook_booking/src/Entity/DoctorProfile.php, Clinic.php, DoctorClinic.php, Specialization.php, Document.php - using ObjectModel pattern matching existing Resource.php entity

Create admin Grid definitions: modules/medbook_booking/src/Grid/Definition/Factory/DoctorProfileGridDefinitionFactory.php, ClinicGridDefinitionFactory.php, SpecializationGridDefinitionFactory.php, DocumentGridDefinitionFactory.php
Create admin Grid query builders: modules/medbook_booking/src/Grid/Query/DoctorProfileQueryBuilder.php, ClinicQueryBuilder.php, SpecializationQueryBuilder.php, DocumentQueryBuilder.php

Create Form types: modules/medbook_booking/src/Form/DoctorProfileType.php, ClinicType.php, SpecializationType.php - with Polish labels (Specjalizacja, Wyksztalcenie, Lata doswiadczenia, Jezyki, Certyfikaty, Numer NIP, Numer PWZ, Adres, Miasto, Kod pocztowy, Wojewodztwo, Telefon, Email, Godziny otwarcia)

Create Admin controllers: modules/medbook_booking/src/Controller/Admin/DoctorProfileController.php (index, create, edit, delete actions), ClinicController.php, SpecializationController.php, DocumentController.php - following existing ResourceController pattern

Add routes for new controllers to config/routes.yml: admin_medbook_booking_doctor_profile_* (index, search, create, edit, delete), admin_medbook_booking_clinic_* (index, search, create, edit, delete), admin_medbook_booking_specialization_* (index, search, create, edit, delete, toggle_active)
Register new services in config/admin/services.yml: grid definitions, query builders, data providers, grid factories for DoctorProfile, Clinic, Specialization, Document grids
Register new controllers in config/services.yml with proper DI arguments

Update the main module class getTabs() to add new admin tabs: AdminMedbookBookingDoctors (Lekarze), AdminMedbookBookingClinics (Przychodnie), AdminMedbookBookingSpecializations (Specjalizacje), AdminMedbookBookingDocuments (Dokumenty)

Create Twig templates for new admin pages: views/templates/admin/doctor_profile/ (index.html.twig, create.html.twig, edit.html.twig), views/templates/admin/clinic/ (index.html.twig, create.html.twig, edit.html.twig), views/templates/admin/specialization/ (index.html.twig, create.html.twig, edit.html.twig)

Add default Polish specializations data as a fixture method in the module install(): Kardiologia, Dermatologia, Endokrynologia, Gastroenterologia, Ginekologia, Neurologia, Okulistyka, Ortopedia, Pediatria, Psychiatria, Pulmonologia, Radiologia, Reumatologia, Urologia, Stomatologia, Laryngologia, Alergologia, Onkologia, Medycyna rodzinna, Chirurgia ogolna
Update the BookingType form to include visit_type (Typ wizyty) and insurance_type (Ubezpieczenie) select fields
Update sql/uninstall.sql to drop all new tables
acceptance_criteria: All new Entity classes pass PHP syntax check
All new Grid definition, query builder, controller, and form type classes pass PHP syntax check
New SQL tables are defined in install.sql with proper foreign key relationships
Routes file has all new admin_medbook_booking_doctor_profile_*, admin_medbook_booking_clinic_*, admin_medbook_booking_specialization_* routes
Services YAML files properly register all new grid factories and controllers
Module getTabs() returns entries for Lekarze, Przychodnie, Specjalizacje, Dokumenty
visit_type and insurance_type columns exist in the booking table SQL
All admin labels are in Polish
verification: Run: find /projects/sandbox/PrestaShop/modules/medbook_booking/src/ -name '*.php' -exec php -l {} \; | grep -v 'No syntax errors' to verify no PHP syntax errors
Run: grep -c 'id_specialization\|id_clinic\|id_doctor_profile\|id_document' /projects/sandbox/PrestaShop/modules/medbook_booking/sql/install.sql to confirm new tables exist
Run: grep 'visit_type\|insurance_type' /projects/sandbox/PrestaShop/modules/medbook_booking/sql/install.sql to confirm new booking columns

Run: grep -c 'admin_medbook_booking_doctor_profile\|admin_medbook_booking_clinic\|admin_medbook_booking_specialization' /projects/sandbox/PrestaShop/modules/medbook_booking/config/routes.yml to count new routes
findings: All new files needed git add -f due to modules/* gitignore pattern. All PHP files pass syntax checks. 41 files changed, 3102 insertions. Medical domain entities use Doctrine ORM attributes pattern matching existing Resource entity. Grid system follows the standard GridDefinitionFactory + QueryBuilder + GridFactory triplet. Controllers follow same pattern as ResourceController.
